related.title: Sigma Correlation：滑動窗口邊界與跨租戶分組
related.titleEn: Sigma Correlation: sliding-window boundaries and tenant grouping
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付48列來源分類、複合join鍵、pcap邊界測試與18筆流程歷史，不製造未曾捕捉的影像或封包。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver source classifications, composite join keys, pcap-bound checks and timeout flow histories, without fabricating uncaptured packets.
related.difference: 建立tenant、user、time、event_id四欄，明確寫出窗口開閉端點、重複ID策略與分組鍵。
related.differenceEn: Create tenant, user, time and event-ID fields, explicitly defining interval endpoints, duplicate policy and grouping keys.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 流程逾時事件不應被強制填入虛構封包編號；可定位比例只是證據型態分布，不是規則正確率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 48筆合成警示中30筆對應真實封包、18筆由流程逾時產生；只對前30筆提供pcap索引。 可定位到封包的比例30/48=62.5%；其餘18筆須沿flow歷史追查。
本課使用(t−W,t]，而非假定所有後端都一致；tenant必須加入分組以避免相同帳號名跨租戶合併。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 租戶A同一user在0、59、60秒各有一筆，租戶B在60秒也有同名user；於t=60、W=60評估。 A窗口為(0,60]，只計59與60兩筆；B事件不得加入A的計數。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Timeout events must not receive invented packet numbers; packet-locatable fraction describes evidence types, not detector correctness. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Of forty-eight synthetic alerts, thirty are packet-backed and eighteen are flow-timeout events; only the former have pcap indexes. Packet-locatable fraction is 62.5%; investigate the remaining eighteen through flow history.

This exercise uses (t−W,t], without assuming universal backend behavior; tenant belongs in the grouping key. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Tenant A has same-user events at 0,59,60 seconds; tenant B has a same-named user at 60; evaluate at t=60 with W=60. A’s window is (0,60], counting only the events at 59 and 60; tenant B contributes nothing to A.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: RFC 3227：揮發證據的截止時間排程與可保存範圍
related.titleEn: RFC 3227: deadline scheduling for volatile evidence preservation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付48列來源分類、複合join鍵、pcap邊界測試與18筆流程歷史，不製造未曾捕捉的影像或封包。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver source classifications, composite join keys, pcap-bound checks and timeout flow histories, without fabricating uncaptured packets.
related.difference: 以合成工作表比較兩種非搶占排程，分別記錄開始、完成、截止與遲到狀態；所有動作只模擬檔案保存，不讀取真實記憶體。
related.differenceEn: Compare two nonpreemptive schedules using a synthetic worksheet. Record start, completion, deadline and lateness for each task; simulate preservation with local fixtures without reading real memory or collecting live credentials.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 流程逾時事件不應被強制填入虛構封包編號；可定位比例只是證據型態分布，不是規則正確率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 48筆合成警示中30筆對應真實封包、18筆由流程逾時產生；只對前30筆提供pcap索引。 可定位到封包的比例30/48=62.5%；其餘18筆須沿flow歷史追查。

RFC 3227強調揮發性與記錄保存流程；本例採單一工作者、已知時間、互不相依的簡化模型，非通用現場鑑識排程最佳化證明。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 工作A用時2分鐘截止3，B用時4截止8，C用時1截止10；從0開始；每個完成時間等於開始加用時。 A-B-C完成於2、6、7，三份及時；B-A-C完成於4、6、7，A超過截止3分鐘，只有兩份及時。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Timeout events must not receive invented packet numbers; packet-locatable fraction describes evidence types, not detector correctness. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Of forty-eight synthetic alerts, thirty are packet-backed and eighteen are flow-timeout events; only the former have pcap indexes. Packet-locatable fraction is 62.5%; investigate the remaining eighteen through flow history.

RFC 3227 emphasizes volatility and documented collection. This exercise assumes one worker, known durations and independent tasks; its schedule comparison is not a universal optimization claim for live forensic acquisition. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Task A lasts two minutes and expires at minute 3; B lasts four and expires at 8; C lasts one and expires at 10. Start at zero and compute completion from start plus duration. The A-B-C order completes at 2, 6 and 7, preserving all three on time. B-A-C completes at 4, 6 and 7; A misses its deadline by three minutes, leaving two timely acquisitions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
